B.rationale: Rolling basin: gentle west rise 48m, dominant NE castle hill 78m, lower east 42m, keeping the 768m square walkable rather than walled. River meanders with 34m bend, 22m channel, 28deg upstream phase, and a 118m soft valley floor to carve but not canyon. 388 trees scatter on slopes and avoid pads. Terrain stays deterministic sampled triangles; pads and bridge approaches grade locally while preserving the channel.

D.concept: A 768 m natural-magic river valley with deterministic rolling terrain, a 22 m meandering channel, and two real material-region bridges at y=288 and y=548. Four irregular settlements reuse the accepted 045 recipes and hold sixteen enterable homes/shops each, scattered by seeded rejection sampling around reserved central squares. Facades face their hubs with yaw variety; pads are graded and roads are footprint-avoiding terrain-A* paths. The four-tower castle crowns the north-east hill.
D.title: Willowbend Vale: Four Hearth-Districts on the River
